title: 组件库开发
html:
组件库开发

核心概念

一个好的组件 API 应该让常见用法简单、复杂用法可能。遵循"Convention over Configuration"原则——合理的默认值减少必填参数，灵活的扩展点支持高级定制。

graph TD
    API[组件 API 设计]
    API --> SIMPLE[简单性<br/>常用场景零配置]
    API --> CONSISTENT[一致性<br/>相似组件相似接口]
    API --> COMPOSABLE[可组合性<br/>小组件组装大功能]
    API --> ACCESSIBLE[可访问性<br/>内置 ARIA 支持]
    API --> TYPED[类型安全<br/>完整的 TypeScript 类型]

五条原则之间存在张力：过度追求可组合性会抬高使用门槛，过度内置默认值又会削弱表达能力。实践中以"常用场景零配置、复杂场景有出口"为准绳，用合理的默认值降低简单用法的成本，用扩展点保留复杂用法的空间。

原则 含义 常见反模式
简单性 常用场景零配置 必填参数过多、默认值缺失
一致性 相似组件相似接口 同类组件 prop 命名各自为政
可组合性 小组件组装大功能 单个巨型组件承担全部职责
可访问性 内置 ARIA 与键盘支持 语义化缺失、焦点管理靠调用方
类型安全 完整的 TypeScript 类型 滥用 any、丢失泛型推导

Variant 驱动的组件设计

使用 cva（Class Variance Authority）实现基于 Variant 的组件样式系统，结合 Tailwind CSS 实现高度灵活的样式定制。

Button 组件

// packages/ui/src/components/Button/Button.tsx
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { forwardRef } from "react";
import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        primary: "bg-blue-500 text-white hover:bg-blue-600 active:bg-blue-700",
        secondary:
          "bg-gray-100 text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-200 active:bg-gray-300",
        danger: "bg-red-500 text-white hover:bg-red-600 active:bg-red-700",
        ghost: "hover:bg-gray-100 active:bg-gray-200",
        outline:
          "border border-gray-300 bg-transparent hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-gray-100",
      },
      size: {
        sm: "h-8 px-3 text-sm gap-1.5",
        md: "h-10 px-4 text-sm gap-2",
        lg: "h-12 px-6 text-base gap-2.5",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "primary",
      size: "md",
    },
  }
);

interface ButtonProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
  loading?: boolean;
  leftIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  rightIcon?: React.ReactNode;
}

const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  (
    {
      className,
      variant,
      size,
      loading = false,
      leftIcon,
      rightIcon,
      children,
      disabled,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
        disabled={disabled || loading}
        {...props}
      >
        {loading ? (
          <svg className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <circle
              className="opacity-25"
              cx="12"
              cy="12"
              r="10"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="4"
              fill="none"
            />
            <path
              className="opacity-75"
              fill="currentColor"
              d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
            />
          </svg>
        ) : (
          leftIcon
        )}
        {children}
        {rightIcon}
      </button>
    );
  }
);

Button.displayName = "Button";

export { Button, buttonVariants };
export type { ButtonProps };

cn 工具函数

// packages/ui/src/lib/utils.ts
import { clsx, type ClassValue } from 'clsx';
import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge';

function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

export { cn };

复合组件模式

复合组件模式通过 Context 将父组件的状态共享给子组件，让使用者能够灵活组合子组件的顺序和结构。

// packages/ui/src/components/Tabs/Tabs.tsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState } from "react";

interface TabsContextValue {
  activeTab: string;
  setActiveTab: (tab: string) => void;
}

const TabsContext = createContext<TabsContextValue | null>(null);

function useTabsContext() {
  const context = useContext(TabsContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("Tabs components must be used within <Tabs>");
  return context;
}

interface TabsProps {
  defaultValue: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
}

function Tabs({ defaultValue, children, onChange }: TabsProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(defaultValue);

  const handleChange = (tab: string) => {
    setActiveTab(tab);
    onChange?.(tab);
  };

  return (
    <TabsContext.Provider value={{ activeTab, setActiveTab: handleChange }}>
      <div className="w-full">{children}</div>
    </TabsContext.Provider>
  );
}

function TabsList({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div role="tablist" className="flex border-b border-gray-200 gap-1">
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

interface TabsTriggerProps {
  value: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function TabsTrigger({ value, children }: TabsTriggerProps) {
  const { activeTab, setActiveTab } = useTabsContext();
  const isActive = activeTab === value;

  return (
    <button
      role="tab"
      aria-selected={isActive}
      className={cn(
        "px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors",
        isActive
          ? "border-b-2 border-blue-500 text-blue-600"
          : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700"
      )}
      onClick={() => setActiveTab(value)}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

interface TabsContentProps {
  value: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function TabsContent({ value, children }: TabsContentProps) {
  const { activeTab } = useTabsContext();
  if (activeTab !== value) return null;

  return (
    <div role="tabpanel" className="py-4">
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

Tabs.List = TabsList;
Tabs.Trigger = TabsTrigger;
Tabs.Content = TabsContent;

export { Tabs };

使用示例：

<Tabs defaultValue="overview" onChange={(tab) => console.log(tab)}>
  <Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="overview">概览</Tabs.Trigger>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="analytics">数据分析</Tabs.Trigger>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="settings">设置</Tabs.Trigger>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Content value="overview">概览内容</Tabs.Content>
  <Tabs.Content value="analytics">数据分析内容</Tabs.Content>
  <Tabs.Content value="settings">设置内容</Tabs.Content>
</Tabs>

可访问性（a11y）

可访问性不是"额外功能"，而是组件库的基本要求。

flowchart TD
    A11Y[可访问性要求]
    A11Y --> KEYBOARD[键盘导航<br/>Tab、Enter、Escape]
    A11Y --> ARIA[ARIA 属性<br/>role、aria-label]
    A11Y --> FOCUS[焦点管理<br/>focus trap、焦点恢复]
    A11Y --> CONTRAST[色彩对比度<br/>WCAG AA 标准]
    A11Y --> MOTION[动画控制<br/>prefers-reduced-motion]

Modal 的可访问性实现

// packages/ui/src/components/Modal/Modal.tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";

interface ModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Modal({ open, onClose, title, children }: ModalProps) {
  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previousFocusRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      previousFocusRef.current = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;
      modalRef.current?.focus();
    }
    return () => {
      previousFocusRef.current?.focus();
    };
  }, [open]);

  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        onClose();
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === "Tab" && modalRef.current) {
        const focusableElements = modalRef.current.querySelectorAll(
          'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
        );
        const firstElement = focusableElements[0] as HTMLElement;
        const lastElement = focusableElements[
          focusableElements.length - 1
        ] as HTMLElement;

        if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === firstElement) {
          e.preventDefault();
          lastElement.focus();
        } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === lastElement) {
          e.preventDefault();
          firstElement.focus();
        }
      }
    },
    [onClose]
  );

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center">
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50" onClick={onClose} />
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="modal-title"
        tabIndex={-1}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-lg rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-xl"
      >
        <h2 id="modal-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
          {title}
        </h2>
        <div className="mt-4">{children}</div>
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="关闭"
          className="absolute right-4 top-4 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
        >
          ✕
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

小结

  • 组件 API 设计遵循"简单性、一致性、可组合性、可访问性、类型安全"五大原则。
  • cva + Tailwind CSS 实现 Variant 驱动的样式系统，灵活且类型安全。
  • 复合组件模式通过 Context 共享状态，让使用者灵活组合子组件。
  • 可访问性（键盘导航、ARIA 属性、焦点管理）是组件库的基本要求。
  • 组件库的包结构和 exports 配置决定了消费者的使用体验。
